result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The environment is characterized by a lack of active traffic control and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at this multi-leg intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection center

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and traffic signals with pedestrian indicators. However, the environment is compromised by narrow, obstructed sidewalks and poor sightlines caused by vehicles parked close to the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk block the view between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and street furniture are placed in the middle of the walking path, significantly narrowing the accessible width.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner sidewalk near the brick building

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and bike lane markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility and effectiveness.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the transverse crosswalk lines to a continental (zebra) pattern to increase visibility to motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks modern safety enhancements like curb ramps or pedestrian signals. Visibility is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing area, increasing the risk of conflict between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk obstruct the sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line to the left of the pedestrian crossing

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of visible curb ramps at the crossing point creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility impairments or those using strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner where the pedestrian is standing

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with embedded streetcar tracks and a significant lack of pedestrian-specific infrastructure. Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and tracks without the benefit of marked crosswalks, refuge islands, or visible pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Embedded Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: The metal tracks create a tripping hazard and can be slippery or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the path of the narrow sidewalk, restricting movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk on the left and right sides of the main road

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner of the intersection block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the blue building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install level, tactile-paved curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.
